scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i resources/assets/css/theme.css -o public/dist/theme.css --minify && tailwindcss -i resources/assets/css/editor.css -o public/dist/editor.css --minify
scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . resources/lang/ars-petal.pot --domain=ars-petal --exclude=node_modules,public && wp i18n update-po resources/lang/ars-petal.pot resources/lang && wp i18n make-mo resources/lang && wp i18n make-php resources/lang && node bin/escape-l10n.mjs
